description: This Java class 'SignalMapperFactory' provides factory methods for instantiating various 'SignalMapper' objects associated with different command and response types in the 'org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter.signals' package. It serves as a centralized factory for creating signal mappers for handling different signal commands related to 'things', 'policies', 'messages', and 'retrieval' operations in the Ditto protocol adapter.

classes.name: SignalMapperFactory
classes.description: A final class providing static factory methods for creating instances of various 'SignalMapper' objects for different Ditto command and response types.
